name: recording-rig-probe
description: Single-tool reachability probe for RDR-001 Phase 0 (A1, A2). Returns a distinctive marker string when called.
long_description: Minimal MCP server with one tool, probe_distinctive_marker_42. Used by recording-rig RDR-001 Phase 0 probes (P0.1 Code, P0.2 CoWork) to verify whether .mcpb extension tools are reachable from each Claude Desktop surface. Returns a fixed sentinel string so an interactive 'please call the tool and report what it returns' check can be scored unambiguously. No side effects, no network, no filesystem access.

tools.name: probe_distinctive_marker_42
tools.description: Returns the fixed string RECORDING_RIG_PROBE_DISTINCTIVE_MARKER_42_OK. Used to verify that .mcpb tools are reachable from the current Claude Desktop surface.
